source: Aria Networks — MFU as defining AI-factory metric; lowest-cost token producer wins via high-performance infra
summary: GPU/XPU utilization in AI factories is critically low (30–45% for training, lower for inference), making network infrastructure the primary bottleneck and value creation opportunity
summary_extended: Baker argues that GPU/XPU utilization in AI factories is critically low — running at only 30–45% during training and even lower during distributed inference — and that the network fabric is the primary bottleneck responsible for this inefficiency. His core quantitative insight is that doubling utilization from 40% to 80% halves the cost per token, making network infrastructure investment the single highest-ROI lever in AI factory economics and the defining competitive advantage for whoever produces the lowest-cost token. Baker explicitly states this thesis is the reason he invested in Aria Networks, a private networking company building high-performance fabric specifically to address this utilization gap. The investment implication is that companies solving the AI network bottleneck — enabling higher Model Flop Utilization (MFU) — will capture outsized value as AI factories scale, while the lowest-cost token producer will dominate the market. No publicly listed pure-play on this thesis exists via Aria Networks (private), and Baker does not name other public beneficiaries with sufficient specificity to add them unambiguously.
detail: Current AI accelerators run at only 30–45% utilization during training and even lower during distributed inference. The network fabric is identified as the primary culprit. Doubling utilization from 40% to 80% halves cost per token and dramatically expands margins, making network investment the highest-ROI lever in AI factory economics.
confidence_evidence: Baker states specific utilization figures (30–45%), quantifies the cost impact (utilization doubling = cost per token halved), and explicitly states this is why he invested in Aria Networks.
quote_fragment: if you take your utilization from 40 to 80, you've dropped your cost per token in half
